hero.subtitle: The authentic Irish pub experience in the heart of Ankara — a rich craft beer selection, rare whiskey collection, and weekly live stage performances.

about.title: Bringing the Irish Spirit to Ankara
about.desc_1: Irish Luck unites Irish pub culture with a modern gastropub experience in the heart of Ankara Tepe Prime. With carefully curated music, a warm wooden atmosphere, and our friendly team, every visit creates unforgettable moments.
about.desc_2: Seven days a week we welcome you with our rich craft beer selection, rare whiskey collection, and exclusive gastropub dishes crafted by our chefs. On live music nights, you'll feel the rhythm of the music with us.
about.location_note: Tepe Prime Avenue, opposite A Block
